kind.description: question: the ask tool was refused; permission: a permission request Claude Code was about to show was refused; deferred: kept with `sideby unattended defer`.

account.description: The account the session ran as.

agentId.description: The subagent a permission request came from.

text.description: The question and its options, the tool and what it was to do, or the deferred text; at most 4000 characters.

waited.description: Minutes the question or permission prompt was on screen with nobody answering before the session went on without an answer (Answer Wait, ADR-0077). Absent when it was never shown.

doneAt.description: When it was marked done; ISO.

project.description: The Project: the git repository of its folder (a worktree counts as its main repository; a folder that is gone counts as the repository of the nearest folder still there), else the folder itself; "" when it has no folder.

projectName.description: The Project's short name, as Session History shows it; "" when it has no folder.

state.description: done: marked done; replied: not marked, and the user typed in its session after it was kept (that does not tell whether it was finished); open: not marked, and nothing typed after it.

repliedAt.description: With `replied`: when the user first typed in the session after it; ISO.

replyCheck.description: Why sideby could not tell whether the user typed in the session afterwards: its session record is gone, or sideby reads no session records of this Family. Only on an open one with a session id.

pending.description: Open Pending Decisions, oldest first; with --all the done ones too; with --project only that Project's.

project.description: The Project, as in each row; "" for those without a folder.

projectName.description: Its short name; "" for those without a folder.

replied.description: Open ones the user typed in their session after.

projects.description: Each Project with a listed one, as the Panel orders them: those with an open one first (the newest open one first), then the rest by their newest one, the one without a folder last.

done.description: `pending done`: the ids this call marked done (not ones done already).

reopened.description: `pending reopen`: the ids this call opened again (not ones open already).

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
